subject: skill frontmatter versioning
fact: Workspace skills carry `metadata: version` in SKILL.md frontmatter alongside name/description; bump it on meaningful changes.
citations: skills/copilot-extension-builder/SKILL.md:4-5 (metadata version 0.2.1); skills/copilot-plugin-builder/SKILL.md (version 0.2.0); skills/copilot-session-telemetry/SKILL.md (version 0.4.0); grep across skills/*/SKILL.md shows ~25 skills with metadata.version
reason: The generic skill-creator skill mandates name+description only, but this repo consistently uses metadata.version across its skills, so future skill edits here must preserve and bump that field instead of stripping it. I initially removed it and had to restore it when the user requested a version bump.
